This release was primarily driven by margin releases on some classes due to a revision in the actuarial methodology. Prior year events such as Hurricane Ian and Storm Elliott (2022) and Hawaiian Wildfires (2023) had an adverse impact on prior year accounts.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year claims reserve release of $196.1m (approximately 3.3% of opening gross claims outstanding). Management reports net releases across most divisions (net $122.0m), with gross movements per the technical provisions showing a $196.1m reduction in gross claims outstanding. Releases were driven by favourable claims development and changes in reserving assumptions/methodology, although parts of the portfolio (notably MAP and Specialty Risk divisions) showed some strengthening. Separately, 2024 experienced several named catastrophe events (Hurricanes Milton, Helene, Beryl) which increased current-year claims but did not reverse the overall prior-year release trend.
